ana: (typo) ana: thanks ops. Can you confirm backfill plan?

mike: recommend adding an alert: vendor_p95 > 30s triggers TTL bump automatically. I'll open a ticket.

serena: messaging for sales drafted: "Late-night enrichment delays caused brief assignment delays for a subset of inbound leads. Ops extended routing timers and reprocessed affected leads; no data lost. DM us if you see missing leads."
